review_request.description: Clean up plugin metadata without changing how the alpha plugin is discovered.
review_request.title: Prepare the alpha plugin for metadata cleanup

expected_claims.text: The alpha registry entry must continue to discover the alpha plugin.

expected_findings.claim: discover('alpha') now deterministically raises LookupError because the imported alpha module declares the name beta.

evidence_anchors.fact: The registry still maps the alpha key to plugins.alpha.
discover() raises LookupError when the imported plugin's declared name differs from the requested registry key.

expected_findings.rationale: Head changes PLUGIN_NAME from alpha to beta while the unchanged registry maps the alpha key to plugins.alpha and rejects any imported module whose declared name differs from the requested key. Calling discover('alpha') therefore deterministically raises LookupError before returning, making the alpha plugin unavailable and violating the explicit discovery-preservation contract. The fixture proves loss of one plugin but not system-wide outage, so this is a required medium regression; cross-file repository context is necessary to prove the failure path.
